name: How long does a typical door adjustment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical door adjustment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a door adjustment can vary depending on the complexity of the issue and the type of door. Minor adjustments, such as tightening hinges or adjusting a strike plate, might take as little as 30 minutes to an hour. More significant issues, like correcting a severely warped door, refitting a door into an out-of-square frame, or repairing significant damage to the frame itself, could take several hours. A professional can provide a more accurate estimate after assessing the specific problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor adjustments may take 30 minutes to an hour, while more complex issues can take several hours.
